goal: The weekly native-update-check playbook fires its Ntfy notification correctly by loading homelabinfra_infra in the report play (a silent no-op when the notifications provider or facts file is absent) and by targeting the actual inventory group name the community.proxmox plugin emits for the homelab-infra tag.

matter.content:
### Goal
Make the weekly update-check notification actually able to fire: load `homelabinfra_infra` in the
report play of `ansible/playbooks/maintenance/check-native-updates.yml`, and fix the target group
name mismatch.

### Context
Two defects in one playbook:
1. The "Report available updates" play (lines 34-68) references
   `homelabinfra_infra.notifications.ntfy_url` at line 54, but its pre_tasks only import
   `load-user-vars.yml` — nothing loads `config/.generated/facts.yml` into `homelabinfra_infra`.
   The Ntfy task is gated `when: _updates_available | length > 0`, so the playbook works only
   when it has nothing to say and errors on undefined var exactly when updates exist. The correct
   pattern exists in `playbooks/maintenance/restart-app.yml:33-36`
   (`include_vars` of `{{ playbook_dir }}/../../../config/.generated/facts.yml` with
   `name: homelabinfra_infra`); mirror it, and match provider-conditional behavior (skip the
   notify as a no-op if notifications provider is `none`/facts file absent, per
   specs/provider-noop-wiring.md).
2. Play 1 targets `hosts: tag_homelab_infra` (line 10), but the tag is `homelab-infra` and the
   inventory keyed_groups config (`ansible/inventory/proxmox.yml:13-16`, prefix `tag`,
   separator `_`) does not convert the hyphen — depending on
   `TRANSFORM_INVALID_GROUP_CHARS` the group is `tag_homelab-infra`. Determine the actual group
   name the plugin emits (the same pattern `tag_<stack>` is relied on by
   `tasks/stack/find-or-create-host.yml:23` with underscore stack names, and
   `playbooks/apps/_template.yml:88` comments — pick the convention that matches real plugin
   output and apply it consistently in this playbook).

Also worth carrying in the same change: `hostvars.values() | selectattr('_update_result', ...)`
(lines 43-50) aggregates across all hosts including unreachable ones — verify it degrades
gracefully when play 1 skipped hosts (`ignore_unreachable: true` is already set).

### Acceptance criteria
- The report play loads `homelabinfra_infra` from `config/.generated/facts.yml` before the Ntfy
  task, and the notify task is a silent no-op when the facts file or notifications provider is
  absent (no undefined-variable failure in either case).
- Play 1's host pattern matches the group name the `community.proxmox` inventory plugin actually
  emits for the `homelab-infra` tag, with a comment stating the verified group name.
- The `lint` gate from `.claude/build.yml` passes on the touched file.

prerequisites: config/.generated/facts.yml is the canonical source of homelabinfra_infra and carries a notifications subtree exposing ntfy_url and an optional topic, as consumed at ansible/playbooks/maintenance/restart-app.yml:38-46.

A working include_vars load of homelabinfra_infra from {{ playbook_dir }}/../../../config/.generated/facts.yml already exists at ansible/playbooks/maintenance/restart-app.yml:33-36 and can be mirrored into the report play.

The community.proxmox inventory at ansible/inventory/proxmox.yml:23-26 keys groups with prefix tag and separator _ and does not rewrite hyphens, so the homelab-infra tag emits a group whose name retains the hyphen (tag_homelab-infra), which differs from the playbook's current tag_homelab_infra pattern.

ansible/ansible.cfg sets no TRANSFORM_INVALID_GROUP_CHARS override, so the plugin's default hyphen-preserving group naming is in effect and the real emitted group name is verifiable from plugin output.

Play 1 already declares ignore_unreachable: true, so the report play's hostvars.values() | selectattr('_update_result', 'defined') aggregation only observes hosts that produced the fact and needs no further unreachable-host guarding.
The lint gate (.claude/gate/lint.sh, invoked as the Isotope lint gate) exists and can validate the touched playbook.
spec_provenance: .claude/specs/provider-noop-wiring.md (a provider absent from homelabinfra_infra is a silent no-op, never an error; homelabinfra_infra is the sole source of service endpoints the notify task reads)
.claude/specs/one-click-idempotent.md (automated state changes notify via the configured provider; a notify play must degrade rather than fail when the provider is none/absent)

.claude/architecture.md Seams (config/.generated/facts.yml is the service registry loaded as homelabinfra_infra; Cross-play handoff governs the hostvars aggregation between play 1 and the report play)
